name: 35235 · Birmingham, AL
findings: ZIP 35235 (Birmingham) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35235 (Birmingham) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35235 (Birmingham) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
